analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is an out-of-bounds read in the format 10/6 trimmed cmap unicode collection path: collect_unicodes() iterates over glyphIdArray.len and directly reads glyphIdArray[i] without bounding against the actual sanitized subtable byte length. For malformed cmap format 10 data, glyphIdArray.len can be derived from attacker-controlled fields (length/startCharCode header interpretation) such that iteration reaches past the end of the blob, leading to BEInt<uint16_t>::operator uint16_t() reading 2 bytes out of bounds. The crash appears in hb-algs.hh conversion, but the missing validation is in this collect_unicodes traversal logic for CmapSubtableTrimmed.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a font with a malformed cmap subtable selected as format 10 (or same trimmed template path) where declared array extent is inconsistent with real table size, and execution of hb_face_collect_unicodes/test_font path (called by hb-shape-fuzzer after shaping). Data flow: fuzzer input -> face/table sanitize/load -> cmap accelerator picks subtable -> CmapSubtable::collect_unicodes dispatches to format10.collect_unicodes -> loop reads glyphIdArray[i] past allocation end.
